purpose: RemoteView is a Slicer scripted module that exports the visible models and segments as GLB and streams them through a user-specified relay server. Phones, tablets and Meta Quest headsets join the session with a 5-character code or QR link. The relay and web viewer live in the same monorepo.
summary: I read the root and module CMake files, RemoteView.py, deps.py, consent.py, links.py, the vendored protocol, and a search of the module for dangerous calls. I found no subprocess use, eval/exec, pickle, disabled TLS verification, or startup side effects. Nothing is sent before the user clicks Start session. There is no default relay URL, and the consent text names the relay host. The pip install of websockets and segno is confirmed in a dialog and happens after Start, not at import. The CMake file lists match the module tree, and the MIT license is present. Remaining points are minor: exact pins on two non-bundled packages, a moving `main` revision, a large monorepo, and a dependence on a user-run relay. I did not read transport.py, panel.py or the other core modules in full.
not_checked: transport.py, panel.py, protocol_client.py, live.py and the other core modules were not read in full
relay-server, web-viewer and other npm components were not audited
No build, load or runtime test was possible
The linked README and user-guide content were not checked
